claim: Practical speech translation covers common language pairs
originalWording: Practical speech translation covers common language pairs

sources.title: Spiritual Machines: The Merging of Man and Machine — Ray Kurzweil

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Ordinary users can access useful two-way speech translation for common languages in everyday contexts.
reference.rationale: Google’s earlier conversation/speech products support this ordinary functional reading well before 2019. Practical translation is a success; errors in idioms, accents or specialist contexts do not justify demanding universal perfect translation.

evidence.title: Start a conversation with Google

strict.criterion: High-quality human-equivalent interpretation is reliable across nearly all ordinary conversational contexts for most common language pairs.
strict.rationale: Availability and useful short exchanges do not establish professional-interpreter reliability in every relevant context.
